resources.string: Sign-in and settings changes are only available while parked.

ShelfDrive requires an HTTPS server URL to protect your credentials and listening data.

ShelfDrive could not securely save the account. No new sign-in was retained.

Before ShelfDrive connects to %1$s, it sends your username and password there for sign-in. If sign-in succeeds, it sends your account or user ID and access token, a random install-scoped app-instance identifier, device model, Android version, and ShelfDrive version. While you use the app—and during enabled background progress sync—it also sends searches, selected titles, playback actions, listening position, progress, and history to that server.\n\nThe ShelfDrive developer does not receive this data. The operator of the server you chose controls its storage, retention, sharing, and deletion. ShelfDrive requires HTTPS, but you should continue only if you trust that server and its operator.
No browser is available. The privacy policy remains shown here in Settings.

ShelfDrive connects only to the Audiobookshelf server you choose. To provide sign-in, browsing, playback, and progress sync, the app sends your username and password during sign-in, then account/user identifiers, access tokens, a random install-scoped app-instance identifier and device details, and listening/playback activity to that server over HTTPS. Your password is not retained.

Account tokens, server settings, listening state, cached artwork, and any offline media are stored on this vehicle. The ShelfDrive developer does not operate your Audiobookshelf server, receive this data, sell it, or use it for advertising. Your server operator controls retention and deletion of server-side data. Disconnecting removes the account from ShelfDrive; use your server to delete server-side records.

The full policy and contact details are available using “View online.”
